proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_creature_consumes_object
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing on_caster_spends_action trigger is scoped to the caster only. Goodberry's core mechanic fires when ANY creature spends a Bonus Action to eat one of the created objects — not just the caster. A new trigger variant is needed for 'a creature spends a specified action economy cost to interact with / consume one of the attached objects.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point

proposed_widenings.name: nourishment
proposed_widenings.justification: The berry provides one day of nourishment — a survival-system mechanic with no corresponding effect atom. This may be DM-agenda (narrative sustenance tracking belongs to the caller), but it is listed as a mechanical effect of eating the berry alongside the HP restoration, so it warrants at least a surface note.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day

notes: The spell's structure fits ongoing_effect with a timed 24-hour duration and a create_object (consumable, count=10) attachment. The heal_hp (fixed 1 HP) and timed duration atoms all exist. The sole blocking gap is the OngoingTrigger: on_caster_spends_action is caster-scoped, but any creature may eat a berry. A new trigger variant scoped to 'any bearer/holder of the attachment object spends the specified action cost' is needed. Nourishment is likely dm_agenda but is listed as a spell effect alongside the HP restoration so is proposed for completeness.
